why: Wiring cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/wiring-1.md, P1 wiring-1.3): a `StatCard href="/orders"` renders a plain `<a>`, and a click loads `/orders` as a new document: the Query cache, the shell state and any in-flight work are gone (`.evidence/cycle-wiring-1/p2.log`, `p3.log`). `routerDefaults()` returns a `link` (`RouterLinkComponent`) and the shipped rule says "`routerDefaults` supplies the router link", but no prop and no provider takes it. `href` is `string` on `StatCard`, `CardAction` (and so `EmptyState action`, `Empty.action`), `col.entity({ href })`, `InnerNav` items, the `ChartCard` target and sidebar block rows; only `PageBar parent.href` takes `string | NavTarget`. Every app with a linked card or row repeats `onSelect` plus `router.navigate`.
what: Every link prop navigates through the router: one place installs the router's `LinkComponent`, and every link prop takes `string | NavTarget`.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/core/provider.tsx or the shell host, wherever the spec installs the link
packages/basalt-ui/src/cards/contract.ts and the cards that render a target
packages/basalt-ui/MIGRATING.md rows, the export-surface snapshot as its generator writes it
change: Spec first (one page): where the router link is installed (the v3 provider, `AppShell`, or a `link` option the router context carries), whether a plain in-app string `href` also goes through it or only a `NavTarget` does, and what an app without a router gets (the plain anchor, as today). Then every link prop of the v3 surface takes `string | NavTarget` and renders through the installed `LinkComponent`; `main.tpl` installs `routerDefaults().link` in the chosen place.
commits: feat: per change in packages/basalt-ui; the template change in its own commit.
proof: make check; a layout or unit test that a linked StatCard click keeps the document (no reload) with the link installed.
acceptance: A Spec states the install point and the string-href rule before code
`StatCard`, `CardAction`, `col.entity`, `InnerNav` items and the `ChartCard` target accept `navTarget({ to })` (type guard)
With the link installed, a click on a linked StatCard navigates without a document load (test)
Without a router, the same props render a plain anchor (test)
out_of_scope: Which part of the card takes the click (v3-wiring-1-statcard-target); renaming onClick/onSelect (v3-wiring-1-api).
